label: Community health checklist
means: GitHub's own score for the health files a repo should have: README, license, contributing, code of conduct, templates
goal_source: GitHub docs, About community profiles for public repositories and REST community metrics (read 2026-11-10): the checklist names the recommended files and the API scores how many are present; goal: all of them
source: state: gh api repos/{repo}/community/profile, GitHub's health percentage and the files it found

label: Leftover branches
means: Branches whose pull request closed or merged, or that are over a day old with none: finished or abandoned work
goal_source: GitHub docs, Managing the automatic deletion of branches (read 2026-11-10): GitHub can delete a head branch once its pull request merges; template goal: no branch outlives its pull request, near 5; a branch under a day old with no pull request is live work
source: state: GraphQL refs under refs/heads (the first 1000) with their pull requests: a branch whose pull request closed or merged, or one older than params.branch_grace_hours (24) with none; the default branch, open pull requests and params.keep_branches do not count

label: Oldest leftover branch
means: Hours the oldest leftover branch has waited since its pull request closed, or since its last commit; 0 when none
goal_source: template goal (2026-11-10): a finished branch is gone within a day, near three; GitHub docs, Managing the automatic deletion of branches: a merged pull request's branch can go at once, so only closed and never-proposed ones wait
source: state: GraphQL refs under refs/heads (the first 1000) with their pull requests: a branch whose pull request closed or merged, or one older than params.branch_grace_hours (24) with none; the default branch, open pull requests and params.keep_branches do not count; each timed from its pull request's close, or from its last commit

label: People with unused write access
means: People who can push but have landed no commit on the default branch in 90 days; access nobody uses is only risk
goal_source: Microsoft Learn, Microsoft cloud security benchmark PA-4 (read 2026-11-10): review access regularly and remove what goes unused, with accounts unused for 90 days flagged; GitHub docs, Viewing people with access to your repository: the list serves offboarding and security reviews
source: state: gh api repos/{repo}/collaborators (people who can push, the first 100) and each one's latest default-branch commit: those with none in params.idle_days days (90, the benchmark's line); org owners left out, since GitHub recommends at least two and no repo review can remove one
